task: r2t3 - verify t1's two accounting repairs and whether t2's judgment of the N1 patch was accurate
overallVerdict: 成立 (sound) - both accounting repairs are correct at the final HEAD, and t2's judgment of the N1 patch was accurate, including two defects it caught that my own harness missed
headline: All three questions come out clean, but only after a head drift I have to disclose. I started at HEAD 146f323, where both accounting items were still wrong in the committed r10t1 (4 timestamps, 48 lines) because the repairs existed only in the working tree. While I was measuring, commit 7b004c0 landed and committed those repairs together with t2's review. At the new HEAD the timestamp list is the exact five, and selfProof now says 47, which matches `git show --numstat 07a28ab` returning 47 insertions for the runbook. Separately, I extracted the N1 guard straight out of the committed r10t2 blob and ran it: /landing-evil throws, /landing.html throws, a 49621 landing is accepted when the port is 49621, and the plain 49620 landing is accepted - 4/4 from the artifact text itself. t2 judged the patch partial, and that verdict is right: I confirmed all four of its defects, including the one that matters - the PS usage comment calls Assert-LandingPage while the function is declared Guard-Page, so an operator pasting that line gets CommandNotFoundException instead of the guard. My own 8-case harness could not catch it because it called the function directly and never pasted the usage line; that is a real gap in how I verified my own patch.
